messages:
sophie: Quick post-launch check-in :rocket: We pushed the benchmark blog + tweet thread at 09:15 PT. Dashboard (link) shows a spike in visits and 420 form submits in the first 3 hours — looks great but the source split is weird. Can someone sanity-check attribution?

raj: Nice! I see GA shows most traffic as organic, but our CRM marks ~60% as paid-social. Suspicious. Did the campaign params get overwritten? :thinking_face: 

ana: tagging @olivia — can Analytics run a join between click events and final form hits? I wonder if our UTM funnel is dropping on redirect. Also, did we accidentally retag the influencer promo?

olivia: On it. Quick note: some bots were hitting the launch page after the tweet — we need to filter by `user_agent` and `event_type = 'page_view'`. Running a query now. Sample SQL I ran: ```
SELECT utm_source, count(*) AS hits
FROM events
WHERE path = '/blog/benchmark'
  AND event_time BETWEEN '2026-03-21 09:00:00' AND '2026-03-21 13:00:00'
  AND user_agent NOT ILIKE '%bot%'
GROUP BY utm_source;
```

mike: Also worth checking inbound lead routing — if the form had no utm, backend defaults to 'organic' but the tagger in the tweet URL uses fbclid and a redirect that sometimes strips utm_medium. Could explain CRM showing paid.

lisa: I pulled a sample of 50 recent leads: 14 have utm_source=twitter, 22 are empty, 14 show 'newsletter' from older promo. So looks like redirect lost params for a chunk.

raj: Ok action items: (1) @olivia to produce deduped join of click -> form -> crm for first 12 hours, filtering bots (due EOD) (2) @mike to update the tweet redirect to persist UTM via 302 with query string (ASAP) (3) @sophie to pause influencer amplification if params aren't fixed. Anyone object?

sophie: No objections. Also please capture engagement quality — leads from the first 3 hours had 2.1x MQL rate vs baseline, so even if attribution wobble, signal is strong. Please add a small card on the weekly metrics dashboard with: raw submits, filtered submits, deduped crm leads, and MQL rate.

olivia: Will send a short CSV and a dashboard snapshot in thread when ready. ETA 4 hours.

mike: I'll roll the redirect fix in the next 30 min and ping ops for the tiny config change.

lisa: I'll re-segment the lead quality report to show UTM presence and initial touch channel. Quick ask — include webinar opt-ins in the same view? We want to know if webinar registrants are inflating the submit count.

sophie: Good call. Include webinar_reg boolean. Thanks team :white_check_mark: We'll reconvene on the weekly metrics call tomorrow at 11am PT with the corrected numbers.

raj: Adding a note to the release tracker: "Post-launch: investigate attribution noise, fix redirect, update dashboard cards."

olivia: Uploaded interim CSV to /shared/analytics/post_launch_1782509876.csv — includes filters and the raw join. Link posted in #marketing.

mike: Patch deployed and verified. Redirect now preserves utm params.

sophie: Perfect. I put a small follow-up tweet clarifying the benchmark thread and added utm_source=twitter&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch. Monitor for any duplicate counts.

lisa: Watching realtime dashboard now — filtered submits stabilized to ~370 in the 3rd hour. Will update the weekly deck.

sophie: Great work, everyone. We'll lock the final numbers tomorrow. Thanks :sparkles:
